arabic text: ZAINAB JO GHAZI YAAD AAYA\nJUN JUN BAZAAR KAREEB AAYA
english translation text: ZAINAB REMEMBERED GHAZI (HAZRAT ABBAS A.S.)\nAS THE BAZAAR CAME NEARER,

arabic text: HATHON SE YA PHIR BALON SE CHEHRE KO CHUPALE SHEHZADI\nYE SHAM SHEHR KI GALIYAN HAI DIL THAAM LE AY AAQAZADI\nFIZZA NE JAB YE BATLAYA, ZAINAB JO GHAZI YAAD AAYA
english translation text: OH BIBI (ZAINAB A.S.), COVER YOUR FACE WITH YOUR HANDS,\nTHESE ARE STREETS OF THE CITY OF SHAAM, KEEP YOUR COURAGE OH LADY,\nWHEN FIZZA SAID THIS TO ZAINAB, SHE REMEMBERED GHAZI (A.S.)

arabic text: MAHOL SHARABI JAB DEKHA BABA KI WASIYAT YAAD AAYI\nKOI TO MUJHE CHADAR LAA DE HONTON PE YEHI FARYAD AAYI\nJAB KOI NAHI CHADAR LAAYA, ZAINAB JO GHAZI YAAD AAYA
english translation text: WHEN SHE SAW THE COURT OF YAZID, ZAINAB REMEMBERED HER FATHER’S LAST WORDS.\n'SOMEONE PLEASE BRING ME A VEIL', THESE WORDS CAME TO ZAINAB’S LIPS.\nWHEN NO ONE BROUGHT A VEIL, ZAINAB REMEMBERED GHAZI (A.S)

arabic text: PHIR SHAM KE LOGON NE BADLA AJDAD KA YUN ZAINAB SE LIYA\nCHADAR CHEENI PATHAR MAARE AUR GARM KABHI PANI PHAYNKA\nDURRA JO SAKINA NE KHAYA, ZAINAB JO GHAZI YAAD AAYA
english translation text: THE PEOPLE OF SHAAM TOOK REVENGE FOR THEIR ANCESTORS FROM ZAINAB IN THIS WAY,\nTHEY SNATCHED HER VEIL, THEY THREW STONES AND SOMETIMES HOT WATER,\nWHEN SAKINA WAS WHIPPED, ZAINAB REMEMBERED GHAZI (A.S)

arabic text: ABBAS KAHAN HAI AY ZAINAB JAB SHIMR HIKHARAT SE BOLA\nGHASH KAHAN LAGAY SAB AHLE HARAM KULSOOM PUKARI WAVAILA\nSAJJAD KO YASRAB YAAD AAYA, ZAINAB JO GHAZI YAAD AAYA
english translation text: 'WHERE IS ABBAS, O ZAINAB', SAID SHIMR VICIOUSLY\nALL THE LADIES STARTED FAINTING, KULSOOM CRIED FOR HELP,\nAT THAT MOMENT SAJJAD REMEMBERED MEDINA, ZAINAB REMEMBERED GHAZI (A.S)

arabic text: KHAMOSH RAHI AULAD E NABI KARBAL SE YAHAN TAK ZULM SAHA\nKHOONI YE MANADI KEHNE LAGA YE KUNBA HAI EK BAAGHI KA\nMAZLOOM JO BAAGHI KEHLAYA, ZAINAB JO GHAZI YAAD AAYA
english translation text: THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET (S.A.) REMAINED SILENT AND ENDURED INJUSTICE,\nIT WAS ANNOUNCED IN SHAAM THAT THIS IS THE FAMILY OF A REBEL,\nWHEN THE OPPRESSED WAS CALLED A REBEL, ZAINAB REMEMBERED GHAZI (A.S)

arabic text: HAR GAAM NAYA EK ZULM HUA LACHAAR MUSAFIR ZAINAB PAR\nZAINAB KO RULAAYA ZAALIM NE NAAQON KE KAREEB NAIZA LAAKAR\nSHABBIR KA SAR JO DIKHLAYA, ZAINAB JO GHAZI YAAD AAYA
english translation text: WITH EVERY NEW GRIEF, THERE WAS MORE INJUSTICE DONE TO HELPLESS ZAINAB,\nTHE CRUEL PEOPLE MADE ZAINAB CRY BY BRINGING THE SPEARS CLOSE TO THE WOMEN,\nWHEN THEY SHOWED HUSAIN’S HEAD, ZAINAB REMEMBERED GHAZI (A.S).

arabic text: FARHAN QAYAMAT KA GHAM HAI MAZHAR NE LIKHA HAI KYA NAUHA\nSHABBIR BINA ABBAS BINA YE PEHLA SAFAR THA ZAINAB KA
english translation text: IT IS LIKE THE GRIEF THAT WILL BE EXPERIENCED ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT,\nTHIS IS ZAINAB’S FIRST JOURNEY WITHOUT HUSAIN OR ABBAS.
